title: Interesting, but needs improvement
body:
Really like this app because it helps me visualise my progress in forming a new, positive identity! However, when it comes to accountability, users will never know their partners’ recent progress; as of now, I can only see my partners’ overall progress, rather than the details.

It would be helpful to have a feature to check their recent progress, and to nudge them if they are falling behind. 

Overall, really innovative and one of the better apps out there for habit-tracking.
author: Emily Limau

title: Habit adjustment
body: I adjusted the timings of my habit, but it’s only reflected the next day. I can’t keep track of the habit today, if I performed it today.
author: Nick29983

title: Climbing 40th storey 😉
body: I continued this habit of doing it at least once a week because it will not only strengthen my legs and give me the advantage when I need to climb mountains.
author: Maggiemag2

title: It will work for me
body: Good to build habits the right way: one at a time. Good UI. The widget could be smaller though and more interactive, so it doesn't open the app to log one repetition.
author: Cético

title: Amazing!
body: Loving this app. So easy to add and record your habits. Enjoying reading the daily tips too. A big Atomic Habits fan so this brings it to me at any time of day. ❤️
author: Cas88L

title: The best app for building habits
body: This app is phenomenal. I’ve been looking for an app like this for ages and I’ve finally found this. This app is made by James Clear (author of Atomic Habits) so I knew this would be a great app. It has so many amazing features like being able to build a streak for my habits which make sure I feel intrinsically motivated to carry out the habit every day to build the streak. It also has this feature where you can have accountability partners which makes it so much more fun. Strongly recommend people who are serious about changing their lives to download this app.
author: arjunpalakkal
